desc: Read the input string S from standard input.
Compute the prefix function (KMP failure array) for combined in O(n) time.
Let `l = pi[-1]` be the length of the longest palindromic suffix of S.
Form the answer as `S + rev[:len(S) - l]` and print it.
Verify with the given examples (ABC → ABCBA, Z → Z, TREE → TREERT).
